claims.claim: 14-3-3 proteins bind phosphoserine-containing proteins through two motifs, RSXpSXP (mode 1) and RXY/FXpSXP (mode 2); the bound peptide is extended, with a tight turn at the pS+2 Pro (cis).
claims.source: Yaffe et al. 1997 Cell, PMID 9428519 (abstract read via Europe PMC)

claims.claim: 14-3-3 acts as a dimer; the dimer binds tandem phosphoserine motifs bidentately.
Structures of all seven human 14-3-3 isoforms bound to ligands; specificity determinants for phosphopeptide orientation in the amphipathic groove; domain flexibility.
claims.source: Yang et al. 2006 PNAS, PMID 17085597, PMC1859916 (abstract); the gamma entry from this work is 2B05 (inferred from release date and title, not checked)

claims.claim: 14-3-3 gamma residues R57 and R132 (native numbering) interact with the phosphoserine of the bound protein (input R56, R131).
LARP1 Ser548 is a recorded phosphosite; it is residue 7 (S7) of chain A (LARP1 542-552).

In the peptide PKGLSASLPDL only S7 is followed by X-Pro (S7-L8-P9), the pS-X-P core of both 14-3-3 motifs; S5 (S5-A6-S7) is not. No Arg at -3/-4 of S7 (L4, G3), so the peptide fits neither full consensus; K2 at -5.
claims.source: motif reading of PMID 9428519 against the FASTA, as counted here

claims.claim: 23 crystal/EM structures of human 14-3-3 gamma exist at 100% identity, most with bound phosphopeptides in the groove (e.g. 6S9K 1.60 A, 6ZBT 1.80 A, 6A5S 2.10 A).

not_known: No paper on the 14-3-3:LARP1 pS548 interaction or its structure was found (Europe PMC: '"LARP1" AND "14-3-3"', 'LARP1 AND Ser548', 'LARP1 AND (14-3-3 OR YWHA*)'); the organisers' description is not in the dossier, so whether the peptide was phosphorylated in the experiment is not confirmed here.
Which kinase phosphorylates LARP1 S548 was not read.
